name: rules-and-insets
description: The anchor for the marks the renderer strokes rather than sets, and the insets it pads a block with: a table whose frame colour differs from its grid at the same width, the rule under a header row at a width no whole pixel can express, an admonition's column rule and its two-sided content inset, a monospaced column beside a plain one, and a sidebar's bottom padding. Every one of them was wrong while the typographic anchors passed, because none of them is typography.
